Messages.Author: Reyda
Messages.Body:
Hi =)
i've just got a simple question

I bleed another meth with, say, Mitchell. The defending meth has only one
vampire untapped: Hugo. He atempts to block, since he matches my 0 stealth
with zero intercept. I then play "Mask of thousand faces" with Gratiano. The
cards says "action resumes when you left it". The problem is : since Hugo
has -1 intercept against Lasombras, how is it handled ? Depending of the
moment i play the mask, can i choose if the bleed does or doens'nt pass
through - i mean by playing "Mask" at a point which i were already blocked
or still unblocked ? All i have to say is "you blocked" before plying the
card ?
That means can i enter combat with hugo in this way, or since he has -1
intercept, i am forced to pass through his block ?

reyda
--

size of the fight in the dog.
